verdict.rationale: Ollama exposes a REST API plus Python/JS client libraries and OpenAI-API compatibility that developers can call from applications (ollama-gh-4, ollama-docs-9/10/11/12), which in practice supports streaming responses, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents a streaming parameter, SSE/chunked response format, or a code example showing token-by-token consumption. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of the stream flag or chunked output, independent confirmation of streaming behavior in hands-on reports.
